reason: The cited evidence shows ML can predict yield strength and Young's modulus using physical features (E3) or composition (E1), but none of the cited passages provide specific prior evidence for integrating explicit microstructural descriptors, predicting fracture toughness with ML, or achieving the claimed 30-50% RMSE reduction. The evidence is therefore only loosely related to the key premises.
premises: Explicit microstructural descriptors (nanoprecipitate size/distribution, chemical fluctuations) can be integrated into an ML model.
Integrating these descriptors with physical features (elastic constants, D parameter, VEC) reduces prediction RMSE by 30–50%.
The model will predict fracture toughness, a property difficult to predict with prior methods.
The approach reduces computational overhead compared to existing high-cost methods.
